payload.contamination_notes: AUTO-M-LOCK (CHANGELOG 2026-07-08): this lock was produced mechanically from eloratings.net only — the process cannot see an odds source, and no analyst formed a judgment. Instrument J is absent in v1 by design; it must be added pre-market by an odds-clean session (score.py audits the j-bearing version's timestamp against first odds contact). | J added 2026-07-16 by an odds-clean session: analyst has seen NO market price for m103 or m104 (odds/ contains no file for either match at amend time -- verified immediately before this amend). Evidence bundle m104_esp_arg_prelock.md was gathered by an odds-firewalled subagent and passed firewall.py CLEAN on first validation before the analyst read it. No Opta final-specific win probability existed (the gathering agent deliberately withheld a stale pre-semifinal tournament-winner number rather than misattribute it); Dimers (quarantine-adjacent) and Nate Silver PELE (paywalled) numbers were not extracted. advisor() unavailable this session; owner switched the session model to Fable 5 mid-session and the DECISION_PROTOCOL section-7 J-basis acceptance was performed by Fable in-session (recorded in j.basis).

basis: J deviates from M by NET +1 d_eff toward Spain (M d=32 -> J d=33; ~0.1pp on the 90' vector), the net of TWO OFFSETTING decomposed factors (m96 lesson: no undecomposed bundles). J~=M on the 90' vector is the honest output of a two-sided situation; the real J content is in the qualify layer (pk_h 0.45, see below). J=M would also have been legitimate; the tiny net is computed, not engineered.

FACTOR 1, tactical_stylistic_matchup -4 (toward Argentina): Argentina's tournament-leading set-piece output maps onto the ONLY crack in Spain's historic defensive record. Argentina side (well-anchored): 5 set-piece goals, most at the tournament, up from 2 at WC2022 (real YoY improvement); 3 headed goals despite third-shortest squad by average height; 3 further goalscoring possessions originating from corners; aerial win rate only 48.1% -> the output comes from delivery/movement/finishing, not raw aerial dominance (ESPN/Sofascore 07-16). Spain side (thin, n=1, honestly flagged): the single goal conceded all tournament was a crossed header (De Ketelaere rising over Cubarsi, Belgium QF) -- against 0.31 xGA/match and 0.05 avg shot-quality conceded, both joint-historic lows since 1966. Anchored type: data-backed structural asymmetry citing both teams' actual numbers. Absorption: Argentina's set-piece story is publicly written up -> residual only. Mechanism-type self-flag: tactical_stylistic_matchup is 0/2 J-better in this project's ledger (r32_esp_aut, m102 -- where the aerial mechanism materialized in the OPPOSITE direction on the pitch; n<5, informational). All of the above -> smallest size class (-4), deliberately below the m100/m102 +10 class.

FACTOR 2, rest_travel +5 (toward Spain): Argentina has 4 rest days (semi 07-15) vs Spain's 5 (semi 07-14), AND Argentina played two extra-time matches earlier in the knockouts (R16 Cape Verde: level at 111' before winning in ET; QF Switzerland: winner at 121') vs Spain's zero ET all tournament; Messi (39) played every minute of the semi and was visibly fatigued late (match reporting 07-15) though uninjured. Partial offset folded into the size: Spain's longer travel leg (Dallas->NJ vs Atlanta->NJ; no sourced mileage found, flagged as gap not estimated). Absorption: rest-day counts fully public -> partly market-priced (m96 lesson), residual only. Mechanism-type self-flag: rest_travel n=2, J-better 1/2, mean RPS delta -0.0071 (mixed; n<5, informational). Conservative +5, well below m100's +20 which had a far larger asymmetry (120min+PK + charter + venue change).

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- Messi finisher premium: tournament overrun is real (5.3 xG -> 8 goals) but the doctrine requires CAREER goals-minus-xG anchoring and the bundle only sourced tournament-level figures; m99/m102 precedent (finisher premium declined when symmetric/unanchored). Spain's mirror-image xG underperformance (14.96 xG -> 8 goals) is equally public process data; feeding either side in is regression-to-mean speculation the market prices fine.

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- Argentina flank vulnerability vs Spain's wide attack (Yamal/overlapping backs): the 50.0% left / 30.6% right chance-concession split is real Opta data, but the bundle itself flags the Spain-specific mapping as the gathering agent's own inference ('no source directly stated this'), AND it shares the wide/cross theme with Factor 1's counter-consideration -- including both would double-count one underlying structure. Declined on anchoring discipline, not because the story is implausible; it is the tempting Spain-ward narrative and declining it is the two-sidedness check.

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- tempo axis: preview prose speculates Argentina may sit deeper, but no confirmed low-block formation, no extreme weather, no anchored low-event evidence. J_SPEC requires concrete evidence; declined.

CONSIDERED AND DECLINED -- 'Argentina's Elo is results-inflated / ran hot through the knockouts': m99-banned family (systematic-divergence story usable as GAP EXPLANATION only; feeding it in makes J a market simulator).

qualify_home uses pk_h=0.45 (not the 0.5 default): E.Martinez is undefeated across four international shootouts (2022 WC QF Netherlands + final France; Copa America 2021 Colombia, 2024 Ecuador) and Argentina's cycle-level shootout success (86%, only semifinalist above 50%) vs Unai Simon's career shootout save rate ~26% (7 of 27 -- near GK base rate, NOT a standout weakness) and Spain's 1-of-5 World Cup shootout history (small-n, mostly different eras). SAME keeper, SAME magnitude as m102 (0.45) and m100 (0.55 for the Dibu side) -- deliberately identical to avoid evidence-reuse inflation across matches. Counterweight logged: Martinez's in-tournament save rate 57.2% (down from 70.7% club form), close-range 33.3% among the tournament's three lowest (Opta 07-16) -- that is shot-stopping, not shootout, so it does not negate the pk premium but caps any temptation to deepen it. Affects the qualify layer only, not the B1 1x2 vector.

FABLE ACCEPTANCE (DECISION_PROTOCOL section 7): advisor() unavailable this session; owner switched the session model to Fable 5 mid-session (2026-07-16) and the J-basis acceptance was performed by Fable in-session: both factor magnitudes and the pk layer approved; one tightening applied -- the Yamal-out amend trigger was pre-registered with a CONCRETE magnitude (see invalidation) instead of 'recompute at the window'.
